back: Writing that explores an issue from several sides in a balanced way before reaching a reasoned judgement.
Each side gets developed points and examples, not just a token sentence.
Introduction; all points for; all points against; conclusion.
Introduction; aspect 1 (both sides); aspect 2 (both sides); aspect 3; conclusion.
It is often argued that…; Supporters claim…; Critics point out that…; Many people feel…
On balance…; Weighing these arguments…; In the final analysis…
Weighs both sides already discussed and gives a judgement, often qualified (provided that…); no new arguments.
Discuss; consider both sides; advantages and disadvantages; a blessing or a curse?
Two columns, For and Against, with at least two developed points in each.
